autonomy: Let controller choose features/preprocessing/estimator/hyperparameters through solution.py and justify intent using development evidence. Named RF/Ridge/boosting methods in prior options remain suggestions, not a forced method menu. Source baseline completion remains available.
query_channel: Sanctioned aggregate dev MAE is intentionally exposed and can contain information about targets. Finite query/output bounds limit it but do not prove information-theoretic nonleakage or adversarial covert-channel absence. Claim direct file/network/output-path isolation only within tested boundary, not absolute zero information transfer.
data_prior_exposure: Public Kaggle data can have pretraining/source familiarity; custody of local held-out labels is not proof of unseen test knowledge.
final_selection: Lock selected eligible development code hash before final refit. Do not let a final_refit intent introduce new selected source, fit-driven human substitution or archive-best hidden score.
safe_output: Raw stdout/stderr/exceptions/prediction vectors never forwarded. Public identity hashes and bounded aggregate metrics are admitted channels, not semantic confidentiality proofs.
budget_semantics: Prime continuation counts/tokens are between-turn checks. Must separately bound current provider/tool/OS work; report observed overrun explicitly rather than certify monetary caps from counters alone.
